title: The Morning Star of Hope (U Khlur)
cultural_context: Classic allegory from Ka Duitara Ksiar celebrating the lone Morning Star (U Khlur Step) shining before sunrise over the eastern ridges of the Khasi plateau. Represents unwavering faith, truth, and hope that sustains travelers through the darkest nights.
lyrics_khasi:
Ha ka suin ba iong me tyngshain marwei,
Ko Khlur ba shai jong ka step-phyrngab!
Me pyni ia ka lynti ia ki nongiaid-wir,
Me ring ia ka jingshai ban pynpeh ia ka dum!

La ki lyoh ki tap ia ka pyrthei baroh,
Me ieng triang khlem khih khlem phet;
Ka jingkyrmen jong ngi me pynim pat sa shisien,
Ko Khlur ba thiang jong ka Ri Khasi!
lyrics_english:
Across the dark velvet firmament thou shinest alone,
O radiant Morning Star of early dawn!
Thou pointest out the hidden trail to weary wanderers,
Drawing forth the morning light to scatter every shadow!

Though dense mountain clouds shroud the sleeping world,
Thou standest steadfast, unmoved and unwavering;
Thou revivest our hope once more with radiant dawn,
O sweet, pure Star of the Khasi hills!

stanzas.title: U Khlur Step-Phyrngab (The Dawn Star)
stanzas.khasi:
Ha ka suin ba iong me tyngshain marwei,
Ko Khlur ba shai jong ka step-phyrngab!
Me pyni ia ka lynti ia ki nongiaid-wir,
Me ring ia ka jingshai ban pynpeh ia ka dum!
stanzas.english: In the dark night you shine solitary, bright star of early dawn! Showing lost wanderers the way, drawing light to banish darkness.

stanzas.title: Ka Jingkyrmen ba Ieng Triang (Steadfast Hope)
stanzas.khasi:
La ki lyoh ki tap ia ka pyrthei baroh,
Me ieng triang khlem khih khlem phet;
Ka jingkyrmen jong ngi me pynim pat sa shisien,
Ko Khlur ba thiang jong ka Ri Khasi!
stanzas.english: Though clouds envelop the earth, you stand unshakable and true. Reviving our hope once more, sweet star of the Khasi land!

vocabulary.step-phyrngab: The very first break of dawn before sunrise; early morning twilight
vocabulary.nongiaid-wir: Wanderer, pilgrim, traveler who has lost the mountain trail
vocabulary.ieng triang: To stand firm, resolute, unshakable, unwavering
